name: Reactify
author: WP Plugify

sections.description:
Reactify helps to make your content come alive using interactive emoji reactions. Users will be able to click on the emojis they would like to express their feelings, and each emoji will display a count number that indicates its popularity. This system is simple to use and fun!
Through smooth animations and a host of emojis , users can quickly express Laughter, Love, Surprise, or Excitement. The one click-reactions with numbers make everything more engaging and interactive, making users feel like they are a part of something fun and exciting.

Features and Options

  • Embedded Customer Reactions
  • Highly Customizable
  • Spam Filters
  • Dynamic Reaction Setting
  • Easy Setup
  • Integration with Third-party platforms
  • 13+ Emojis Loaded
  • Amazing Reaction Count

Support

Get free dedicated support from our developers.
sections.installation:
1. Login to your WordPress Admin Area

    1. Go to Plugins > Add New
    2. Type “Reactify” into the Search and hit Enter.
    3. Find this plugin Click “Install now”
    4. Activate The Plugin
    5. Use Reactify on any themes that allow users to review and reaction.

    Manual Installation

    1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org repository
    2. On your WordPress admin dashboard, go to ‘Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin’
    3. Upload the downloaded plugin file (reactify.zip) and click ‘Install Now’
    4. Activate ‘Reactify’ from your Plugins page.
    5. Use Reactify on any themes that allow users to review and reaction.
sections.faq:
Can I use Reactify with any WordPress theme?

  • Yes, It can be used with any WordPress theme.

What is the plugin license?

  • This plugin is released under the GPL license.
